I went to school for a few years, so I can read what is written on a fertilizer bag, but I still farm the way my mother taught me and the way my neighbors do. This plot is only 0.24 hectares and I am renting it, so I will not put much money into it — I need to save my cash for the land my own family owns. I will spread manure from my cows and sheep on this plot because I already have it at home and it costs nothing except our labor, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer. One bag from the cooperative is too expensive for such a small piece of land, and last season I saw that the good fertilizer was already gone by the time I got there. I will plant seed I saved from my own harvest, not the improved kind from the agro-dealer, because my own seed has always grown well enough and I do not want to take a loan. I do not need pesticide for this crop, and there is no river or pump nearby for irrigation anyway. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, so I will not hire outside workers.
